name: Vanaspati.AI
description: Vanaspati.AI is an advanced artificial intelligence and agronomic decision-support platform designed to diagnose plant diseases, identify botanical species, and provide targeted biological, chemical, and nutritional prescriptions.

paragraphs: Vanaspati.AI is a next-generation agronomic intelligence and computational plant science ecosystem engineered to solve the most pressing challenges in global food production and crop health. By orchestrating Hierarchical Computer Vision (YOLOv11 ROI localization, Vision Transformers, ResNet-9), Large Language Models specialized for plant science (PLLaMa — arXiv:2401.01600v1), and an Enterprise Neo4j Agronomic Knowledge Graph, Vanaspati.AI delivers instant foliar pathology diagnosis, verified taxonomic species identification, and certified curative recovery roadmaps.
